
# Installation Management
Setting up an installation and achieving stability is just the beginning. The real challenge lies in ensuring it runs seamlessly—day after day, week after week, and even year after year. Your goal is to keep your "customers" satisfied and confident in the day-to-day operations, without being constantly called to resolve minor issues.

This document provides an overview of the common challenges you may encounter and the strategies you can implement to address them effectively.
